name: cavemio-privacy-mask
title: Privacy mask
description: A frosted optical unmasker for sensitive keys, salaries and tokens, with auto-hide timeout and one-tap copy.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Preserves exact horizontal character metrics to prevent layout shifts across sibling components.
- Screen reader status region politely reports "Hidden" until explicitly revealed by user action.
- Clipboard copy cleans up asynchronous timeouts on component unmount.
- Reduced motion eliminates blur transitions and updates text states instantaneously.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value
props.description: – · The sensitive string to be masked and copied.

props.name: label
props.description: "Confidential value" · Accessible label for assistive technologies.

props.name: trigger
props.description: "click" · How the unmasking interaction is initiated.

props.name: maskStyle
props.description: "blur" · Visual mask format: optical blur, bullet dots, or truncated token.

props.name: copyable
props.description: true · Shows an integrated copy button with self-drawing checkmark.

useCases.title: API keys & developer settings
useCases.description: Protect live Stripe, OpenAI, and database secret keys from accidental exposure.

useCases.title: Fintech & banking dashboards
useCases.description: Conceal total net worth, bank account numbers, and portfolio balances during screen sharing.

useCases.title: HR & payroll records
useCases.description: Mask employee base compensation and equity allocations in team directories.

useCases.title: Auth & recovery tokens
useCases.description: Show two-factor backup recovery codes with one-tap copy and instant re-masking.

features.title: Optical blur preserves width
features.description: The 5px blur applies directly over the real string, so the component never shifts width or changes height between masked and unmasked states.

features.title: Multiple reveal triggers
features.description: Supports click-to-toggle, hover-to-peek, and hold-to-reveal for varying levels of security sensitivity.

features.title: Self-drawing copy checkmark
features.description: Copying the secret draws a crisp SVG checkmark and resets to the clipboard icon after 1.8 seconds.

features.title: Auto re-mask safety net
features.description: Automatically re-masks the value after 6 seconds of inactivity to prevent leaving sensitive keys exposed on open tabs.

features.title: Instant Escape dismiss
features.description: Pressing Escape immediately re-applies the mask and returns keyboard focus cleanly.

features.title: Screen reader privacy
features.description: Announces "Hidden" when masked, preventing screen readers from speaking private keys aloud in public spaces.

states.title: masked
states.description: Frosted 5px optical blur with 60% opacity keeps text confidential while maintaining exact character width.

states.title: revealed
states.description: Blur dissolves to 0px over 200ms with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); eye icon cross-fades into eye-off.

states.title: copied
states.description: Copy button swaps to an emerald checkmark that draws its path in 320ms and restores after 1.8s.

states.title: auto re-mask
states.description: Timer automatically returns to masked state after 6000ms of inactivity.

states.title: escape dismiss
states.description: Escape key immediately cancels the unmasked state without waiting for the timer.
